fabric_pipeline.summary: Seeds project defaults, workspace selection, preview sizing, runtime pack counts, and tensor readiness hints.
Authors the scene graph bootstrap, asset catalog bootstrap, PBR material contract, SVG mask contract, preview buffers, tensor features, and session report.
Projects a substance-painter-style texture set, layer stack, and export preset report from Kain-owned session truth.
Projects SVG mask documents, anchor-driven vector motifs, and reusable decal shapes for the material lane.
Uses the native helper to apply a narrow sculpt mutation proof and emit a sculpt signature.
Builds graph and topology health reporting from authored scene and sculpt outputs.
Emits PyTorch-oriented training readiness and plan summaries without pretending the runtime is fully wired.
Emits tensor inference readiness and model-serving summaries.
Runs a compute preview and material bake pass across the shared preview buffers after PBR and SVG authoring receipts are materialized.
Builds channel-pack export receipts for metal-rough, ORM, height, emissive, and custom packed delivery.
Builds the publish and package report through a Kain-authored bridge that includes the material export lane.

workspace_pages.title: Publish And Automation Command Deck
workspace_pages.hero_title: Delivery, receipts, automation, and tensor readiness under one publish deck
workspace_pages.hero_summary: The delivery lane should own bundle readiness, recurring jobs, and release artifacts without forcing operators to leave the authored session model.

extension_seams: the universal studio shell is manifest-driven and generated, but interactive command dispatch still needs a live runtime bridge
viewport host now consumes bundle-authored universal gizmo defaults, but live per-tool gizmo switching still needs a session-to-host bridge
tensor lane currently reports readiness and plan state rather than executing a full typed tensor artifact contract
simulation lane currently materializes plan-oriented reports rather than a true solver runtime
compositor lane currently materializes rebuild plans rather than executing a first-class compositor graph runtime
